description: This PHP class 'DetailedLeaveRequest' manages leave request data and calculations within the OrangeHRM system. It handles fetching, sorting, and analyzing leave requests, including leave periods, balances, breakdowns, actions, and workflows.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequest
classes.description: Class for managing and calculating detailed information related to a leave request, including fetching leaves, calculating days, leave periods, balances, and managing actions and workflows.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches all leaves related to the leave request and sets internal leave data.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leaves sorted by date.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the leaves collection and internal data structures.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Adds a single leave to the internal collection and resets sorted flag.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave entries.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of days for the leave request.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Provides detailed date information for the leave, including start/end, duration, etc.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdown
methods.description: Provides breakdown of leaves by status, excluding holidays and weekends.

methods.name: getLeaveBalances
methods.description: Calculates and returns leave balances per leave period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriods
methods.description: Identifies leave periods for the leave entries.

methods.name: hasMultipleStatus
methods.description: Checks if the leave request has multiple statuses.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns actions allowed for this leave request based on current status and workflows.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches allowed workflows for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action (approve, reject, cancel) is allowed.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow for a specific action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave request if it has a single status. Throws exception otherwise.
